Name: HxW Sweetheart Hairstyles - Magical Girl Pastels Edition
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/buIbPlm.png[/img]

[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4]For all the pastel lovers who don't want to fight with Stardew's base hue shifting for hair, Hime and I are happy to bring you our [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27595]Sweetheart Hairstyles [/url]﻿in FIVE pre-colored hues for your fashion needs.

You can use any and all of these packs together, but be aware that each of them contains all of our original hairstyles so that can get pretty huge pretty quick!

My suggestion (if your PC is a little more on the slower side) would be to pick which styles you want and delete the others so you don't have to load them all into your save.

I wanted to make short versus long vs curl vs straight but there are too many ways to categorize them, so I stuck with keeping each color palette as its own pack and y'all can choose to download whatever you'd like!

[i]Current colors: Blonde, Pink, Purple, Blue, Green[/i][/size][size=3][i]

Future Colors: TBD! [/i][/size][size=3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/y8dJ6qH.png[/img]

[/size][size=4]Credit to my partner in crime [b][url=https://himetarts.wixsite.com/artsite]HimeTarts[/url][/b] for her gorgeous art and gorgeous self. <3

Credit to Sailor Moon and the Sailor Scouts for making me dream about rocking pastel-colored hair at a very young age.[/size][size=3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2bSyOpH.png[/img]
[/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=5]
